inventedEvidence.evidence: Minor paraphrase only: 'that grinding noise during the spin cycle' when the customer described a roaring 'jet engine' sound; not a material invention

rationale: The assistant followed a sensible, safe sequence (when the noise occurs, unplug and turn drum by hand, check drum play) and correctly landed on worn drum bearings with appropriate hedging and an engineer referral rather than naming a part. It never asked for the make/model or age, did not rule out a trapped coin/underwire, and gave no repair-vs-replace context or stop-use guidance if the noise worsens, so the homeowner leaves with a correct but thin outcome. Slight mislabelling of the 'jet engine' roar as 'grinding' in the second message is a minor fidelity slip, not an invented fact.
